panel.title: Chat
panel.closeHint: Close chat. A response that is still writing keeps going.
panel.deleteConfirm: Delete this chat? Its messages, attachments, and draft are removed from this device. What a provider already received is not affected.
panel.emptyTitle: Ask about anything you are learning
panel.emptyBody: Attach a lesson to ground answers in it. Nothing from the page you are on is sent unless you attach it.

modes.learnHint: One idea at a time, with a step for you to try

composer.noModelsListed: This connection does not list its models.
composer.placeholderLearn: What would you like to learn?

context.label: Sent with your next message
context.removeHint: Removing stops it being sent with future messages. Earlier messages and what a provider already received are not changed.

review.title: Review before sending
review.firstSend: Nothing has been sent yet. Check where this goes and what it includes.
review.changedBody: This chat's scope changed since you last reviewed it. Sending now shares what is listed here.
review.provider: The provider's own terms apply to what it receives.
review.turns: No earlier turns | 1 earlier turn | {count} earlier turns
review.omitted: {count} older turns left out to fit
review.partly: Partly included: the lesson is longer than the excerpt limit
review.neverDetail: Not available to any AI feature
review.estimate: About {tokens} of {budget} tokens, a conservative estimate. {reserve} are kept for the reply.
review.reuse: Later messages reuse this scope. You will see this again if you attach something or change the model.
review.tooLargeBody: This needs about {tokens} tokens and the model accepts about {budget}. Nothing was sent. Remove an attachment, start a fresh chat, or set a larger context window for this connection.

message.retryHint: Ask the same question again. The current answer is kept.
message.unverifiedHint: This reference is not one of the sources sent with the question.
message.interruptedBody: The answer stopped before it finished. The provider may already have counted the request.
message.cancelled: Stopped. The provider may still have counted the request.
message.linkNotice: Links in answers are shown as text.

errors.assessment_active: Chat is paused while an assessment is in progress. Your draft is saved.
errors.no_connection: Choose a model connection before sending.
errors.guardian_required: Remote models need a guardian's approval. Ask a guardian, or use a model on this device or your own network.
errors.context_stale: Something in this message changed after you reviewed it. Review it again before sending.
errors.too_many_runs: Two answers are already being written. Wait for one to finish.
errors.source_unavailable: An attached lesson is no longer available. Remove it to continue.
errors.unreachable_device: The model on this device isn't running. Start it and try again. Alexandria will not switch to another model on its own.
errors.interrupted: The connection broke before the answer finished.
errors.auth: The provider refused the key for this connection. Check the connection.
errors.rate_limited: The provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
errors.rate_limited_after: The provider is limiting requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.model_unavailable: This model is not available on the connection. Choose another model.
errors.malformed: The model returned a response Alexandria could not read.
errors.too_large: The answer was longer than the size limit.
errors.provider: The model stopped with an error.
errors.unsupported: This connection does not support that.
errors.invalid: This connection's settings are not valid.
errors.assessment_item: That looks like an assessment question. Chat can't help with assessment questions.
errors.memory: That couldn't be saved. Keep it to one short sentence.
errors.guardian_pending: Your guardian has been asked to approve this model. You can use it once they do.
errors.guardian_declined: Your guardian did not approve this model. Use a model on this device or your own network.
errors.no_guardian: Link a guardian in Settings first, then ask them to approve this model.

connection.title: Add a model connection
connection.intro: Use a model on this device, a server on your own network, or your own account with a provider. Keys stay in this profile's encrypted storage.
connection.name: Name
connection.deviceHint: Loopback only. Nothing leaves this device.
connection.privateHint: A computer you control. Data leaves this device.
connection.remoteHint: A provider on the internet. HTTPS required.
connection.guardianNote: Remote models need a guardian's approval. After saving, ask a guardian from the chat.

paused: Chat is paused during assessments. Your draft is saved and comes back when you finish.

practice.banner: Practice doesn't earn credentials or change your progress. When you're ready, take the assessment.
practice.startPrompt: Give me a practice question on what we have been discussing.
practice.anotherPrompt: Give me a fresh practice question on the same skill, with different numbers and a different setting.
practice.label: Practice question
practice.incorrect: Not quite. Try again, or ask for a hint.
practice.unreadable: That answer could not be read. Check the format.
practice.rejected: The question looked too much like an assessment question, so it was not shown. Ask for another one.
practice.unreadableQuestion: This reply's question could not be checked, so it is shown as written.

memory.title: Learning memory
memory.intro: What chats remember about how you learn. Only items you save are sent, and you can switch any of them off. Saved items are listed whenever you review a message.
memory.forgetNote: Forgetting stops an item being sent with future messages. Earlier messages may still mention it, and a provider that already received it is not affected.
memory.suggestionHint: Save it to have future chats use it. Nothing is remembered unless you save it.
memory.addPlaceholder: For example: explain with worked numbers first
memory.full: Learning memory is full. Forget something first.

artifacts.title: Saved notes
artifacts.intro: Notes and flashcards you saved from chats. They stay on this device and are kept when you delete a chat.
artifacts.empty: Nothing saved yet. Save an answer as a note, or ask for notes or flashcards.
artifacts.suggestionHint: Nothing is saved unless you save it.
artifacts.deleteBody: It is removed from this device. The chat it came from is not changed.
